scope: Agent-owned dress/upper panel/sleeve/neckline test scope; not a requester definition.
comparison: A posed fashion test beside a blank wall would expose fit clearly. The chosen inhabited public interior gives material and form a visible practical action and aftermath while keeping the torso and sleeves readable. The scene remains one plausible photograph at creativity=1 and surreal=0.

preliminary_test_gates.criterion: Dress body panel, sleeves, and neckline visibly belong to the same worn garment; endpoints not inferred from labels.
The selected upper-panel fit relationship must be visibly supported by fabric-to-body contact or separation and its defining seam/fold behavior.
The selected sleeve fit must show sleeve-to-arm width/contact or separation over a useful exposed length.
Any adopted neckline relationship must show both garment edge and the relevant upper-body endpoint in-frame.
Place, immediate activity, its visible trace, and expression connect into a readable moment.
Face and short dark bob provide visible reference guidance without assigning an actual identity or biography.

strict_rule: Hidden, partial, unsupported, or unobservable selected fit relationships cannot pass. User judgment remains not_yet_received.
